name: PrivacyDot
tagline: See which apps are using your microphone and camera.
minimumTarget: Windows 7 SP1 with .NET Framework 4.8; detection capabilities vary by Windows version and driver
cameraAttributionRequirement: Windows 10 version 1703 or newer with the sensor activity monitor available
features: Detected apps grouped by microphone or camera
Confirmed force quit for eligible matching processes
privacy: No telemetry or device-usage uploads. Detection reads local Windows metadata without recording audio/video. GitHub is contacted for update checks; installer downloads require confirmation.
limitations: Best-effort detection depends on Windows and drivers
Older Windows versions have limited camera detection
Force quit may close multiple matching windows and lose unsaved work
